## Customize the HTML Tag of the Post Title **Pro**

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/html-tag-of-the-post-title/>

**Location**: Appearance → Customize → Front Page → Widget

ColorMag provides the option to change the heading tag for the widget post title.

Under the Markup option, select the required markup for your post title. You can set your post title to be in **Heading 2** and** Heading 3**.

## How to Change View All Text in TG Widget Bundle **Pro**

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/change-view-all-text-in-tg-widget-bundle/>

Location: Appearance > Customize > Front Page > Widget

ColorMag Pro allows you to change the View All text in the TG Widget Bundle.

View All Text in ColorMag

Most of the Widget from the TG Widgets Bundle have View All link that links to that particular category page. Under the View All , you can change that particular text to anything you like.

## Unique Post System **Pro**

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/unique-post-system/>

Location: Appearance → Customize → Front Page → General → Unique Post System

ColorMag Pro allows you to avoid the same post repeating over and over on the same page.

Almost a dozen widgets are bundled in the theme ColorMag which are used to display various posts along with its featured image. These widgets display the latest posts or posts from some specific category. So, when many widgets are used on the same page, like the Front Page of the ColorMag Pro demo site, it is likely that the posts are repeated. That means the same posts can be displayed in several places by the different widgets.

In order to avoid this, under the Unique Post System, you can toggle the option to the right area to show posts only one time on a page.

## Hide Blog Posts / Static Page

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/enable-or-disable-latest-blog-posts-or-static-page-content-on-the-front-page/>

**Location**: Appearance → Customize → Front Page → General → Hide blog posts/static page

By default, WordPress displays the latest posts on the homepage. In the ColorMag theme, we add the posts on the front page with the help of the widget area.

In this case, the latest posts still get appear, even after adding the content. In order to prevent the latest post from appearing on the front page, you can disable the option.
